In brief

  • The calculators run entirely in your browser. What you enter (sizes, prices) is not sent to a server and is not stored.
  • The website is free and funded by advertising from Google AdSense and by affiliate links to Amazon.
  • Cookies and similar technologies for advertising are only used if you agree in the consent dialog. You can change your decision at any time.
  • No analytics or tracking tools such as Google Analytics are used.

Hosting

The website is hosted by Netlify, Inc., 101 2nd Street, San Francisco, CA 94105, USA. When you visit the pages, the host processes technically necessary data in server log files, in particular IP address, date and time of access, the page visited, browser and operating system. This is needed to deliver the website securely and reliably. The legal basis is legitimate interest under Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.

Data may be transferred to the USA in the process. The transfer is based on appropriate safeguards, such as the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or EU standard contractual clauses. More information is in Netlify's privacy policy.

Advertising with Google AdSense

This website shows ads through Google AdSense. For users in the European Economic Area and Switzerland the provider is Google Ireland Limited, Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland (“Google”).

So that ads can be delivered, counted and protected against fraud, your browser loads content from Google servers. The following data in particular is processed: IP address, information about your browser and device, the page visited, date and time, and information about which ads you were shown and whether you clicked on them.

Third-party cookies: Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies and similar technologies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this website or other websites. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to you based on your visits to this and other sites on the internet. Besides Google, other advertising partners (third-party vendors and ad networks) may serve ads and set cookies for this purpose. Which vendors these are, what they use data for and how long they keep cookies is shown in the consent dialog under the settings or the list of vendors.

Personalised and non-personalised ads: If you agree, ads can be tailored to your interests. Without consent, Google shows only non-personalised or limited ads where possible. These are based, for example, on the content of the page and your approximate location; data may also be processed for these to prevent fraud and measure reach.

Legal basis: Storing and reading information on your device for advertising purposes only happens with your consent (§ 165(3) of the Austrian Telecommunications Act 2021 and § 25(1) of the German TDDDG). The subsequent processing of personal data for personalised advertising is based on your consent under Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR. Where ads are served without consent, the legal basis is the legitimate interest in a free, advertising-funded website (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

Transfers to third countries: Google may also transfer data to Google LLC in the USA. Google LLC is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework; Google also uses EU standard contractual clauses.

Objection and settings: You can turn off personalised advertising from Google in Google's ad settings. You can opt out of other vendors' use of cookies for personalised advertising at www.youronlinechoices.eu or www.aboutads.info. Google explains how it uses data on partner websites at policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites; Google's privacy policy applies in general.

Amazon Associates Programme

This website takes part in the Amazon Associates Programme. Some links to products on Amazon are affiliate links and are marked “paid link”. They contain a partner ID that tells Amazon you came from this website. If you then buy something there, I receive a commission. The price you pay stays the same.

Loading this website does not send any data to Amazon and does not set any cookies. Only when you click such a link are you taken to Amazon. Amazon may then set cookies and process data under its own privacy policy, in particular to attribute the order to the partner. The legal basis for the links is the legitimate interest in a free, advertising-funded website (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). More information is in Amazon's privacy notice.

Managing consent

On your first visit, a consent dialog asks whether you agree to the use of cookies and the processing of data for advertising. The dialog is provided by Google and certified under IAB Europe's Transparency and Consent Framework (TCF). Your decision is stored in a cookie on your device so that the dialog does not appear on every page. The legal basis for this is the legal obligation to be able to prove consent (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR).

You can withdraw or change your consent at any time with effect for the future, using the “Cookie settings” link at the bottom of every page. Alternatively, you can delete cookies in your browser; the dialog will then appear again on your next visit.

Offline use (app)

So that the calculators also work without an internet connection and can be installed as an app, your browser uses a so-called service worker to keep a copy of the pages, fonts and program files in browser storage. No personal data is sent to me in the process. You can clear this storage at any time in your browser settings.

Fonts and program libraries

Fonts and program libraries (for example for the 3D view) are loaded directly from this website. There is no connection to Google Fonts or other external servers for this.

Contact by email

If you send me an email, I only process your details to answer your enquiry. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, or Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR for enquiries about advertising space. My mailbox is run by Google (Gmail). The data is deleted as soon as it is no longer needed for this purpose and no statutory retention periods apply.

Your rights

You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection. You can withdraw consent at any time; this does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before the withdrawal. To exercise your rights, use the email address above.

If you believe that the processing of your data breaches data protection law, you can complain to a supervisory authority. In Austria this is the Datenschutzbehörde, Barichgasse 40–42, 1030 Vienna, www.dsb.gv.at. You can also contact the authority where you live, in the UK for example the Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk).
